productOverview.headline: Droni Kielelezo cha Upimaji
productOverview.description: DJI Phantom 4 RTK bado ni chaguo lililothibitishwa na kuaminika kwa upimaji wa mipaka na ramani za uhandisi, ikichanganya kamera yenye shutter ya mitambo na ujumuishaji wa RTK usio na mshono kwa usahihi wa juu wa ramani.

keyFeatures.headline: Vipengele Muhimu
keyFeatures.description: Kwa nini Phantom 4 RTK bado ni kielelezo cha tasnia.

items.title: Kamera ya CMOS ya Inchi 1
items.description: Azimia ya MP 20 yenye shutter ya mitambo kwa picha za ramani zisizo na distoro.

items.title: Ujumuishaji wa RTK Usio na Mshono
items.description: Inatoa usahihi wa ±cm 1-2 usawa na ±cm 2-3 wima shambani.

items.title: Uhakika Uliothibitishwa
items.description: Kiwango cha muda mrefu cha tasnia kwa upimaji wa mipaka na uhandisi.

items.title: Usahihi wa Juu wa Ramani
items.description: GSD ya ~cm 2.7 kwa mwinuko wa m 100 kwa orthomosaic za kina.

model3d.headline: Chunguza Phantom 4 RTK kwa 3D
model3d.description: Buruta kuzungusha modeli na tumia gurudumu la kutanua au kidondoa kukaza.

cameraSystem.headline: Kamera
cameraSystem.description: Kamera maalum ya ramani iliyoundwa kwa usahihi.

positioningAndAccuracy.headline: Usahihi
positioningAndAccuracy.description: RTK ya daraja la upimaji iliyojengwa ndani.

specs.headline: Vipimo vya Kiufundi
specs.description: Maelezo kamili ya kiufundi kwa DJI Phantom 4 RTK.

detailedSpecifications.headline: Vipimo vya Kiufundi vya Kina
detailedSpecifications.description: Vipimo kamili vya mtengenezaji kwa ndege, kamera, betri na kidhibiti cha mbali cha DJI Phantom 4 RTK.

items.label: Max Service Ceiling Above Sea Level
Operating Frequency
items.value: 2.400-2.483 GHz (Europe, Japan, Korea); 5.725-5.850 GHz (United States, China)

items.label: Transmission Power (EIRP)
items.value: 2.4 GHz: CE/MIC/KCC < 20 dBm; 5.8 GHz: SRRC/FCC/NCC < 26 dBm

items.label: Hover Accuracy Range (RTK disabled)
items.value: Vertical: ±0.1 m (vision positioning), ±0.5 m (GNSS positioning); Horizontal: ±0.3 m (vision positioning), ±1.5 m (GNSS positioning)

items.label: Image Position Offset
items.value: Camera center relative to onboard D-RTK antenna phase center: (36, 0, 192 mm) along aircraft body axes, auto-applied to image Exif data. Positive x/y/z point forward, rightward, and downward respectively.

items.label: Mapping Accuracy
items.value: Meets ASPRS Accuracy Standards for Digital Orthophotos Class III. Actual accuracy depends on lighting, patterns, altitude, mapping software, and other factors.

items.label: Ground Sample Distance (GSD)
items.value: (H/36.5) cm/pixel, where H is aircraft altitude relative to the shooting scene (m)

items.label: Data Acquisition Efficiency
items.value: Max operating area of approx. 1 km² per single flight at 182 m altitude (GSD approx. 5 cm/pixel), meeting ASPRS Class III standards

items.label: Velocity Range
items.value: ≤31 mph (50 kph) at 6.6 ft (2 m) above ground with adequate lighting

items.label: Operating Environment
items.value: Surfaces with clear patterns and adequate lighting (>15 lux)

items.label: Lens
items.value: FOV 84°; 8.8 mm / 24 mm (35 mm format equivalent: 24 mm); f/2.8-f/11, auto focus at 1 m to infinity

items.label: Supported SD Cards
items.value: MicroSD, max capacity 128 GB. Class 10 or UHS-1 rating required, write speed ≥15 MB/s

sections.title: Kituo cha Kushitua Betri yenye Akili (WCH2)

items.label: EIRP
items.value: 2.4 GHz: CE/MIC/KCC < 20 dBm; 5.8 GHz: FCC/SRRC/NCC < 26 dBm

items.label: Max Transmission Distance
items.value: FCC/NCC: 4.3 mi (7 km); CE/MIC/KCC/SRRC: 3.1 mi (5 km), unobstructed and free of interference
